points.K1: 管理控制：先于设施建立
points.K4: 外部要求：法律法规在先
points.K5: 内部制度：放进法律框架
points.K14: 安全手册：按本实验室编写
points.K15: 操作规程像飞行检查单
points.K19: 医学监护与暴露后救治
points.K22: 受控文件：版本、归档、权限
points.S1: 同事状态异常，关心并报告
points.S3: 新人先跟做，考核后独立

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一本厚厚的空白手册，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thick blank manual and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天讲管理控制。
overlay: 写下来，照着做：管理控制

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开手册，里面是空白页和勾选框
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens the manual to show blank pages and checkboxes.
shots.narration: 说白了：写下来，照着做。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验室门口，对着墙上一排空白文件夹皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a row of blank binders on a shelf by the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 阿杰嘀咕：做实验，要这么多文件？

shots.scene: 老周拍拍阿杰的肩，指着文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The older man pats the young male student on the shoulder and points at the binders.
shots.narration: 老周说：这些是实验室的规矩。

shots.scene: 王老师抱着空白文件夹走过来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over carrying blank folders.
shots.narration: 王老师说：我带你一本本看。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：先于设施建立
shots.scene: 一张空白建筑图纸旁，先放上一本手册
shots.prompt_en: A blank manual is placed next to a blank building blueprint first. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制是生物风险管理的基石，
overlay: 管理控制：先于设施建立

shots.section_title: 管理控制：先于设施建立
shots.scene: 时间轴：手册在前，起重机和楼房在后
shots.prompt_en: A timeline: a manual comes first, followed by a crane and a building. No people.
shots.narration: 要在设计建楼之前就定下来，

shots.section_title: 管理控制：先于设施建立
shots.scene: 空白手册和空白政策文件并排
shots.prompt_en: A blank biosafety manual and a blank policy document side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 以安全手册和管理政策的形式。

shots.scene: 五个图标：文件、规则、日历、讲台、档案盒
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a document, a rule book, a calendar, a lectern and an archive box. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制包括书面政策、规则、

shots.scene: 图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The five icons light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 工作安排、培训和记录。

shots.scene: 检查人员翻看空白记录本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator flips through a blank record book during an inspection.
shots.narration: 一切都要写下来，检查要看记录。

shots.scene: 三个仪表：时钟、次数计数器、严重程度指针，都往下调
shots.prompt_en: Three dials: a clock, a counter and a severity gauge, all turned down. No people.
shots.narration: 目标是减少接触的时间、次数，

shots.scene: 风险箭头向下
shots.prompt_en: A risk arrow pointing downward. No people.
shots.narration: 和严重程度，把风险降下来。

shots.section_title: 外部要求：法律法规在先
shots.scene: 一面空白法规书架，书脊空白
shots.prompt_en: A bookshelf of law books with blank spines. No people.
shots.narration: 外部要求来自单位以外：
overlay: 外部要求：法律法规在先

shots.section_title: 外部要求：法律法规在先
shots.scene: 地球图标、国旗样空白旗、法槌图标
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon, a blank flag and a gavel icon. No people.
shots.narration: 国际指南、国家标准和法律法规。

shots.section_title: 外部要求：法律法规在先
shots.scene: 老周和王老师在查阅法规书
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator look through a law book together.
shots.narration: 订制度前，先把国内法规查清楚，

shots.section_title: 外部要求：法律法规在先
shots.scene: 两个图标：安全帽和双螺旋，各配感叹号
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with exclamation marks: a safety helmet and a DNA double helix. No people.
shots.narration: 职业健康、基因工程尤其要注意。

shots.section_title: 内部制度：放进法律框架
shots.scene: 实验室小房子图标，里面一本空白手册
shots.prompt_en: A small laboratory icon with a blank manual inside. No people.
shots.narration: 内部制度由本单位按需要制定，
overlay: 内部制度：放进法律框架

shots.section_title: 内部制度：放进法律框架
shots.scene: 空白手册被放进一个大框里，框上是法槌图标
shots.prompt_en: The blank manual is placed inside a large frame marked with a gavel icon. No people.
shots.narration: 但必须放在法律框架里面。

shots.section_title: 内部制度：放进法律框架
shots.scene: 手册伸出框外的一角被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A corner of the manual sticking out of the frame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能和法规打架。

shots.scene: 十二个彩色方块拼成一面墙
shots.prompt_en: Twelve colorful blocks forming a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制种类很多：

shots.scene: 第一排方块亮起：计划、委员会、人员、培训、评估、规范
shots.prompt_en: The first row of blocks lights up with icons for plan, committee, staff, training, assessment and practice. No people.
shots.narration: 管理计划、委员会、人员和培训，

shots.scene: 委员会方块里三个小圆桌图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside the committee block, three small round table icons. No people.
shots.narration: 委员会有生物安全、动物和伦理的，

shots.scene: 第二排方块亮起：手册、标识、库存、体检、检查、文件
shots.prompt_en: The second row lights up with icons for manual, sign, inventory, health check, inspection and records. No people.
shots.narration: 还有手册、标识、库存、体检，

shots.scene: 最后一块档案盒亮起
shots.prompt_en: The last block with an archive box lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 检查审核和文件记录。

shots.scene: 一张空白要求清单，逐条打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank requirements checklist being ticked line by line. No people.
shots.narration: 单位要找出所有相关要求，逐条落实。

shots.scene: 一个人形耸肩说不知道，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A figure icon shrugging, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能说“我不知道有这规定”。

shots.scene: 老周请一位同事一起审阅空白法规清单
shots.prompt_en: The older man reviews a blank regulation list with the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 拿不准的，请懂法规的人把关。

shots.scene: 从国家到地方的层层台阶，最底层是排水管图标
shots.prompt_en: Steps from national level down to local level, with a drain pipe icon at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 要求来自国家到地方，排水也有规定。

shots.scene: 金字塔：顶层领导图标，中间政策，底层实验台
shots.prompt_en: A pyramid: a leader icon at the top, policy in the middle and a lab bench at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 管理计划是组织、政策和做法的框架，

shots.scene: 老周在空白文件上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank document.
shots.narration: 必须有领导支持，

shots.scene: 每个角色头上一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A check mark above each role icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每个人都要对自己的事负责。

shots.scene: 三环相扣：政策、实践、记录
shots.prompt_en: Three linked rings labeled with icons for policy, practice and records. No people.
shots.narration: 政策变成做法，做法留下记录。

shots.scene: 王老师翻阅阿杰的空白档案
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator looks through the young male student's blank file.
shots.narration: 上岗前要看几样：

shots.scene: 四个图标：学位帽、证书、扳手、时钟
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a graduation cap, a certificate, a wrench and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 学历、培训经历、

shots.scene: 阿杰在王老师面前演示移液
shots.prompt_en: The young male student demonstrates pipetting in front of the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 实际操作能力，要单位来考核，

shots.scene: 空白简历上一段经历被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A section of a blank resume circled. No people.
shots.narration: 相关工作经验也很有帮助。

shots.scene: 空白健康档案，上面有过敏图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank health record with an allergy icon on it. No people.
shots.narration: 健康史要记录，比如过敏，

shots.scene: 采血管图标和冰箱图标
shots.prompt_en: A blood tube icon and a freezer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 必要时留本底血清，

shots.scene: 疫苗瓶图标和知情同意空白表
shots.prompt_en: A vaccine vial icon and a blank consent form. No people.
shots.narration: 按评估和规定预防接种。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标下一个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A person icon under a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 接触高致病性病原，人员按规定审查。

shots.scene: 小研在显微镜前，阿杰在提取台前，各有对勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student at a microscope and the young male student at an extraction bench, each with a check mark.
shots.narration: 按能力分工，谁擅长什么做什么。

shots.scene: 四个图标：新任务、新情况、新设备、新法规
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a new task, a new situation, a new instrument and a new rule. No people.
shots.narration: 换任务、遇新情况、来新设备、

shots.scene: 四个图标都连到一个讲台图标
shots.prompt_en: All four icons connect to a lectern icon. No people.
shots.narration: 出新法规，都要培训。

shots.scene: 王老师在本实验室里给大家讲解设备
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains the team beside the equipment in their own laboratory.
shots.narration: 培训要在本实验室，结合实际。

shots.scene: 别的实验室证书放到本实验室门口，问号
shots.prompt_en: A certificate from another lab placed at this lab's door with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 在别处合格，换地方还得重新学。

shots.scene: 王老师站在阿杰身后看他操作，手拿空白评分表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands behind the young male student watching him work, holding a blank score sheet.
shots.narration: 定期在工作台旁考核，

shots.scene: 日历上循环箭头和讲台图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a circular arrow and a lectern icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不合格就再培训。

shots.scene: 空白培训签到表和证书放进档案盒
shots.prompt_en: A blank attendance sheet and a certificate go into an archive box. No people.
shots.narration: 培训要留记录，能力要能证明。

shots.scene: 三个图标：规范操作、无菌操作、行为守则
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: good laboratory practice, aseptic technique and a code of conduct. No people.
shots.narration: 良好规范包括规范操作、无菌技术，

shots.scene: 实验室墙上贴着空白守则
shots.prompt_en: A blank code of conduct poster on the laboratory wall. No people.
shots.narration: 和本实验室自己的行为守则。

shots.scene: 眼睛、讲台、放大镜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an eye, a lectern and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 靠意识、培训和检查来保持。

shots.section_title: 安全手册：按本实验室编写
shots.scene: 一本手册从别的实验室复印过来，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A manual being photocopied from another laboratory, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全手册要按本实验室编写，
overlay: 安全手册：按本实验室编写

shots.section_title: 安全手册：按本实验室编写
shots.scene: 王老师参照空白模板写手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes a manual using a blank template as reference.
shots.narration: 可以参考模板，不能照搬。

shots.section_title: 安全手册：按本实验室编写
shots.scene: 五本空白手册并排，封面不同图标
shots.prompt_en: Five blank manuals side by side, each cover with a different icon. No people.
shots.narration: 可分为生物安全、动物、安保、

shots.section_title: 安全手册：按本实验室编写
shots.scene: 应急手册和设施运行手册亮起
shots.prompt_en: The emergency manual and the facility operation manual light up. No people.
shots.narration: 应急响应和设施运行等手册。

shots.section_title: 安全手册：按本实验室编写
shots.scene: 王老师和老李一起写设施运行手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer write the facility operation manual together.
shots.narration: 设施手册要和工程人员一起编。

shots.section_title: 操作规程像飞行检查单
shots.scene: 飞机驾驶舱里一张空白检查单
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist in an airplane cockpit. No people.
shots.narration: 操作规程就像飞行员的检查单，
overlay: 操作规程像飞行检查单

shots.section_title: 操作规程像飞行检查单
shots.scene: 检查单逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: Items on the checklist ticked one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 一项项照做，差错就少。

shots.section_title: 操作规程像飞行检查单
shots.scene: 小研在安全柜前，脑袋上冒出问号，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student at a safety cabinet with a question mark over her head, crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 别光靠记忆，

shots.section_title: 操作规程像飞行检查单
shots.scene: 仪器侧面贴着空白规程卡，小研边看边勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure card taped to the instrument; the female graduate student ticks it as she works.
shots.narration: 规程贴在仪器旁，专心操作。

shots.scene: 三个警示标志：电离辐射、生物危害、当心中毒
shots.prompt_en: Three warning signs: an ionizing radiation warning sign, a biohazard warning sign and a toxic warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 标识很重要，

shots.scene: 每个抽屉、垃圾桶都贴满生物危害标志，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Every drawer and bin covered with biohazard symbols, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但到处乱贴，

shots.scene: 阿杰走过满墙标志，视而不见
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks past a wall full of signs without looking.
shots.narration: 大家就视而不见了。

shots.scene: 实验室门上一块生物危害警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory door with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 标识要说清有什么危害，

shots.scene: 门旁一块空白信息牌，配电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank information plate beside the door with a phone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 写明负责人和应急联系电话。

shots.scene: 门上标志旁加了口罩图标和疫苗图标
shots.prompt_en: A mask icon and a vaccine icon added beside the sign on the door. No people.
shots.narration: 需要接种或戴呼吸器才能进的，要标明。

shots.scene: 孕妇图标、免疫低下图标停在门外
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pregnant person and an immunocompromised person stop outside the door. No people.
shots.narration: 感染风险高的人，不进相应区域。

shots.scene: 一台冰箱，门上贴空白清单
shots.prompt_en: A refrigerator with a blank inventory list on its door. No people.
shots.narration: 动物、病原、转基因材料，

shots.scene: 小研取出一管样本，在空白登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes out a tube and signs a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 都要登记，取用留记录，

shots.scene: 冰箱上挂锁，旁边位置图标
shots.prompt_en: A padlock on the refrigerator with a location pin icon. No people.
shots.narration: 写明存放位置和安保级别，

shots.scene: 流程箭头：入库、取用、销毁，连成一条线
shots.prompt_en: A flow line of arrows: stored, used, destroyed. No people.
shots.narration: 来龙去脉，随时查得到。

shots.section_title: 医学监护与暴露后救治
shots.scene: 时间轴：开工前、工作中、结束后，各有体检图标
shots.prompt_en: A timeline with health check icons before, during and after the work. No people.
shots.narration: 工作前、中、后都要关注健康。
overlay: 医学监护与暴露后救治

shots.section_title: 医学监护与暴露后救治
shots.scene: 日历上每年一个体检图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a yearly health check icon. No people.
shots.narration: 定期体检，必要时比对本底血清，

shots.section_title: 医学监护与暴露后救治
shots.scene: 两份血清结果对比，第二份多一个红点
shots.prompt_en: Two blank serum result cards side by side; the second has an extra red dot. No people.
shots.narration: 能发现实验室里有没有暴露。

shots.section_title: 医学监护与暴露后救治
shots.scene: 小研陪阿杰去医务室，手拿空白报告单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student accompanies the young male student to the clinic, holding a blank report form.
shots.narration: 暴露后救治，由单位负责安排。

shots.scene: 三个图标：放大镜看文件、扳手看设施、仪表看设备
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a magnifying glass over a document, a wrench on a building, a gauge on equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 审核看规程有没有照做，

shots.scene: 老李检查设施，王老师在旁记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the facility while the safety administrator takes notes.
shots.narration: 检查看设施是否按设计运行，

shots.scene: 设备上贴空白合格标签
shots.prompt_en: A blank certification label on a piece of equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 检测看设备参数是否合格。

shots.scene: 两位检查人员，一位来自外单位
shots.prompt_en: Two inspectors arrive, one carrying a visitor badge.
shots.narration: 内部审核之外，外部审核更客观。

shots.scene: 卫生和消防人员图标站在新实验楼前
shots.prompt_en: Health and fire inspector icons in front of a new laboratory building. No people.
shots.narration: 新建设施要请主管部门检查。

shots.scene: 两个箭头循环：文件到手，手到文件
shots.prompt_en: Two circular arrows linking a document and a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 写你所做，做你所写。

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕和纸质检查单并排
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen and a paper checklist side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 电子或纸质都可以，

shots.scene: 电脑数据复制到移动硬盘并上锁
shots.prompt_en: Data copied from a computer to a locked backup drive. No people.
shots.narration: 电子的要备份、要保密，

shots.scene: 纸质记录放进档案柜
shots.prompt_en: Paper records filed into an archive cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 纸质的要归档存放。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白日志本上签字确认
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs to confirm entries in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 记录要有人核实确认。

shots.section_title: 受控文件：版本、归档、权限
shots.scene: 两份空白规程，封面分别标版本一和版本二
shots.prompt_en: Two blank procedures with version markers on their covers. No people.
shots.narration: 规程和检查单是受控文件，
overlay: 受控文件：版本、归档、权限

shots.section_title: 受控文件：版本、归档、权限
shots.scene: 版本页上：日期、修改人两栏
shots.prompt_en: A revision page with two blank columns for date and editor. No people.
shots.narration: 改一处就升版本，写明日期和修改人。

shots.section_title: 受控文件：版本、归档、权限
shots.scene: 档案盒和放大镜，旁边一个事故图标
shots.prompt_en: An archive box and a magnifying glass next to an incident icon. No people.
shots.narration: 归档保存，出了事能追溯。

shots.section_title: 受控文件：版本、归档、权限
shots.scene: 复印机复印规程，被打叉；钥匙图标
shots.prompt_en: A photocopier copying a procedure, crossed out with a red X, next to a key icon. No people.
shots.narration: 谁能看有规定，不能随便复印。

shots.section_title: 同事状态异常，关心并报告
shots.scene: 小研发现同事老是走神，在实验台前发呆
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student notices a colleague staring blankly at the bench.
shots.narration: 同事状态不对：疲惫、走神、情绪差，
overlay: 同事状态异常，关心并报告

shots.section_title: 同事状态异常，关心并报告
shots.scene: 小研走过去关心地询问
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and asks with concern.
shots.narration: 先关心问一问，

shots.section_title: 同事状态异常，关心并报告
shots.scene: 高风险操作图标上暂停标志
shots.prompt_en: A pause sign over a high risk task icon. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险操作先缓一缓，

shots.section_title: 同事状态异常，关心并报告
shots.scene: 小研向老周说明情况
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student talks with the older man about the situation.
shots.narration: 告诉负责人，一起想办法。

shots.scene: 菌种管和一个空白来源证明并排
shots.prompt_en: A culture tube next to a blank certificate of origin. No people.
shots.narration: 菌毒种和样本，

shots.scene: 从正规保藏机构图标到实验室，箭头上有空白审批章
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a culture collection icon to the laboratory with a blank approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 要从正规渠道获得，按规定审批。

shots.scene: 两人在走廊私下递菌种管，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two hands passing a culture tube secretly in a corridor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不私下交换，不私自带进带出。

shots.scene: 登记本上记录来源、日期
shots.prompt_en: A logbook entry recording source and date. No people.
shots.narration: 来源、数量都登记在册。

shots.section_title: 新人先跟做，考核后独立
shots.scene: 阿杰站在小研身边看她操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands beside the female graduate student watching her work.
shots.narration: 新人先跟着老手做，
overlay: 新人先跟做，考核后独立

shots.section_title: 新人先跟做，考核后独立
shots.scene: 小研在旁边看阿杰操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches as the young male student does the procedure.
shots.narration: 再在老手看护下自己做，

shots.section_title: 新人先跟做，考核后独立
shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰的空白考核表打勾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator ticks a blank assessment form for the young male student.
shots.narration: 考核通过，才能独立操作。

shots.section_title: 新人先跟做，考核后独立
shots.scene: 阿杰独自操作时，墙上贴着空白联系人牌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student works alone with a blank contact card on the wall.
shots.narration: 有疑问随时问，不硬着头皮上。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排文件夹前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a row of binders.
shots.narration: 回顾：外有法规，内有制度。

shots.scene: 台阶向上，每级一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Steps going upward, each with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 有记录，才能持续改进。

shots.scene: 王老师整理档案柜
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator organizes the archive cabinet.
shots.narration: 最好有专人管文件。

shots.scene: 人员、培训、手册、标识、台账图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons for staff, training, manuals, signs and inventory. No people.
shots.narration: 人员、培训、规程、标识、台账，

shots.scene: 阿杰在自己的空白笔记本上写安全心得
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes safety notes in his own blank notebook.
shots.narration: 也可以自己记一本安全笔记。

shots.scene: 笔记本和受控文件夹，笔记本旁有小提示图标
shots.prompt_en: A personal notebook next to a controlled document binder with a small tip icon. No people.
shots.narration: 但笔记代替不了正式规程。

shots.scene: 欣欣和老周、王老师、阿杰站在文件柜前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the older man, the safety administrator and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the archive cabinet.
shots.narration: 写下来，照着做，再见！
